CONTROLS.SaveMacro: Save Particle and Filter Effects as Macro
CONTROLS.ClearFX: Clear Scene Particle and Filter Effects (Right-click: Disable Region Effects)

Common.DisableAllHint: Setting this will disable effects for all users. It overrides the enable flag. It's mostly a safe guard to deactivate effects when migrations fail. You shouldn't need to set this yourself. After changing this setting, a manual reload is required.
Common.ClearParticleAndFilterEffectsContent: Permanently delete all Particle Effects and Filter Effects from this Scene?
Common.DisableRegionEffectsTitle: Disable Region Particle and Filter Effects
Common.DisableRegionEffectsContent: Disable all active Particle Effect and Filter Effect behaviors on Regions in this Scene? The Region behaviors remain configured and can be re-enabled later.
Common.PowerToggleContextHint: Left-click to toggle. Right-click for reset options.
Common.EnableTooltipsHint: Enables tooltip descriptions for Particle and Filter effect parameters.
Common.HiddenEffectsHint: Toggle effects to hide them from this management list (per-user). Hidden effects can still be enabled via the API.
Common.ApiEffectsNone: No API effects are active on this Scene.
Common.ApiEffectMissing: This API effect no longer exists on this Scene.

Params.AnchorHint: Local coordinates of the origin between 0.0 and 1.0

ParamTooltips.RegionBoundaryAvoidance: Steer animals away from Region boundaries and holes. Available when Orbit is disabled.
ParamTooltips.Gamma: Midtone curve. Lower brightens midtones; higher darkens midtones.
ParamTooltips.Brightness: Overall scene or sprite brightness. 0 = black; 1 = original; >1 = brighter.
ParamTooltips.Contrast: Difference between light and dark. Higher values increase punch.
ParamTooltips.Tint: Apply a solid color tint. Toggle Apply to enable the tint color.
ParamTooltips.Opacity: Global transparency of the effect. 0 = invisible; 1 = fully opaque.
ParamTooltips.Scale: Size/scale amount. 0 = none when available; 1 = maximum configured size for this effect.
ParamTooltips.Blur: Blur radius or strength applied by the effect.
ParamTooltips.Bloom: Bloom intensity—how strongly bright areas glow.
ParamTooltips.Sepia: Sepia toning amount. Higher = stronger vintage look.
ParamTooltips.Threshold: Brightness threshold; lower catches more pixels.
ParamTooltips.Period: Controls an average event interval or animation cycle period in milliseconds. Lower values occur more frequently.
ParamTooltips.Duration: How long the effect or event runs. Units are effect-specific.
ParamTooltips.Speed: Controls motion or animation speed. 0 stops movement when supported; 1 applies the maximum configured speed for this effect.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeStrength: Maximum shake displacement. 0 = no movement; 1 = strongest shake.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeBlur: Adds motion blur in the shake direction. Higher values smear fast impacts more strongly.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeDuration: How long a timed shake or audio-triggered burst remains active, in seconds.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeSpeed: How quickly the shake changes direction. Higher = faster impacts and vibration.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeSmoothness: Smooths the shake path. Higher = softer camera drift; lower = harsher impact jitter.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeDecay: How strongly a timed shake fades toward zero over its duration.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeAxis: Limit shake movement to both axes, horizontal only, or vertical only.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeEdgeProtection: Slightly overscans the composited image while shaking to reduce exposed edges.
ParamTooltips.ScreenShakeTimed: When enabled, the scene effect turns itself off after Duration. Disable for a continuous shake, or enable Audio Aware for audio-triggered bursts.
ParamTooltips.Lifetime: Particle lifetime scale. Higher values keep particles alive longer; 1 = maximum configured lifetime for this effect.
ParamTooltips.Density: Controls how many particles spawn per area. 0 disables spawning when supported; 1 applies the maximum configured density. Higher settings can increase performance cost.
ParamTooltips.SplashDensity: Scales only the animated rain-splash population. Falling rain still uses the main Density control.
ParamTooltips.SplashScale: Scales only the animated rain-splash sprites. Falling rain still uses the main Scale control.
ParamTooltips.Direction: Direction in degrees using geometric coordinates: 0° points right on the x-axis, 90° points up, and angles increase counterclockwise.
ParamTooltips.XAdjustment: Shift the rendered particle field horizontally by grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.YAdjustment: Shift the rendered particle field vertically by grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.FlipHorizontal: Mirrors the particle sprite horizontally when enabled.
ParamTooltips.LineWidth: Controls line width in pixels. Exact behavior depends on the effect.
ParamTooltips.Animations: Select animation types for this effect.
ParamTooltips.Variants: Choose a preset look for this effect.
ParamTooltips.SummerLeafVariants: Choose which Summer Leaves types can appear. Each leaf type includes both color variants. Empty or invalid selection uses Tree Leaves.
ParamTooltips.Anchor: Local coordinates of the origin between 0.0 and 1.0.
ParamTooltips.Spin: Particle spin speed. 0 = no spin; 1 = maximum configured spin speed for this effect.
ParamTooltips.Noise: Noise amount. Higher values make noise more visible.
ParamTooltips.NoiseSize: Grain size scale. 1 = maximum configured grain size.
ParamTooltips.Wobble: Adds random side to side particle movement. Higher = more movement.
ParamTooltips.WobbleFrequency: Controls how fast particles wobble. 0 = slowest configured wobble; 1 = fastest configured wobble.
ParamTooltips.Displacement: Strength of visual warping or displacement.
ParamTooltips.Streakiness: Controls how stretched and banded the filter is along the movement path. Lower values look more like uniform haze, higher values create longer streaks.
ParamTooltips.Lift: Controls how thick the filter is in the middle of each sheet compared to its edges. Lower values are more flat and even; higher values make the centers denser and the edges thinner, adding depth but reducing overall coverage.
ParamTooltips.Glow: Controls glow intensity around the effect. 0 disables glow; 1 applies the maximum configured glow strength.
ParamTooltips.Parallel: Uses parallel rays instead of rays that converge on a source point.
ParamTooltips.Angle: Direction the sunlight rays travel in degrees. 0° = right, 90° = up, 180° = left, 270° = down.
ParamTooltips.Lacunarity: Controls spacing and detail in the ray pattern. Higher values create more tightly packed variation; 1 applies the maximum configured value.
ParamTooltips.BeamLength: Controls the maximum visible ray length. 0 selects the automatic length.
ParamTooltips.FadePercent: Softens region edges by this percent for a smoother blend. Higher = more fade.
ParamTooltips.Rainbow: Overrides Tint and enables a random cycling rainbow effect on particles.
ParamTooltips.Shadow: Enable a drop shadow for the particle sprites.
ParamTooltips.ShadowDistance: Offset distance of the drop shadow. Higher = further away.
ParamTooltips.ShadowBlur: Blur strength on the drop shadow.
ParamTooltips.ShadowOpacity: Opacity of the drop shadow. 0 = invisible; 1 = fully opaque.
ParamTooltips.ShadowOnly: Render only the drop shadow and hide the base particle sprites.
ParamTooltips.Splash: Enable rain splash effects alongside raindrops.
ParamTooltips.Orbit: Enables orbit around center of a container instead of an outward spread.
ParamTooltips.OrbitDistance: Distance from the center of a container for orbiting particles.
ParamTooltips.FillMode: Controls how the glitch effect fills the affected area.
ParamTooltips.Slices: Controls the overall slice layer amount for glitch distortion.
ParamTooltips.Offset: Maximum displacement amount applied by the glitch effect.
ParamTooltips.Seed: Random seed used to vary the generated pattern.
ParamTooltips.RefreshRate: How often the generated pattern re-randomizes.
ParamTooltips.SliceEnable: Enables slice displacement and RGB split.
ParamTooltips.SliceCrosshatch: Adds a second slice band pattern at a different phase for a crosshatch look.
ParamTooltips.SliceCount: Number of horizontal slices. Higher = more fragmented slices.
ParamTooltips.SliceSpeed: How fast the slice pattern scrolls. 0 disables slice scrolling; 1 = maximum configured scroll speed.
ParamTooltips.SliceBurstRate: How often slice sizes/offsets re-randomize, in seconds. 0 disables randomization.
ParamTooltips.SliceOffset: Maximum displacement amount for each slice.
ParamTooltips.SlicePixelation: Adds blocky pixel stepping to slices. 0 = smooth.
ParamTooltips.SliceShardAngle: Adds angular shard-like shearing to slices. 0 = none.
ParamTooltips.MatrixDirection: Direction (degrees) the Glyph field is oriented.
ParamTooltips.GlyphColor: Tint color for glyphs. Toggle Apply off to use the rainbow mode instead.
ParamTooltips.GlyphIntensity: Brightness of the glyph overlay. 0 disables glyph visibility; 1 = maximum configured brightness.
ParamTooltips.GlyphCellSize: Size of each glyph cell in pixels.
ParamTooltips.GlyphMoveSpeed: Speed of Glyph motion simulation. 0 disables movement; 1 = maximum configured Glyph motion speed.
ParamTooltips.GlyphDensity: How many glyph columns are active. 0 = none; 1 = all columns.
ParamTooltips.GlyphSlicePct: If slices are enabled, how much of the slice region gets glyphs.
ParamTooltips.GlyphFlickerSpeed: How fast glyphs blink. 0 disables flicker.

FishType.Name: Choose which fish variant to spawn.

ParamTooltips.RotationStrength: How strongly particles rotate as they move. 0 = no rotation; 1 = maximum configured rotation.
ParamTooltips.Trail: Trail intensity/length behind particle sprites. Higher = longer/stronger trails.
ParamTooltips.LateralMovement: Adds smooth side-to-side drifting to particle movement. Higher = more lateral drift.
ParamTooltips.TokenAvoidance: Move creature particles away from visible tokens while those tokens are moving.
ParamTooltips.TokenAvoidanceDispositions: Select which token dispositions repel these particles.
ParamTooltips.TokenAvoidanceAtRest: Also move creature particles away from stationary visible tokens.
ParamTooltips.TokenAvoidanceRadius: Sets the avoidance radius as a multiplier of the token footprint. 1 is approximately the token's size; values above 1 extend the avoidance area up to 3x.
ParamTooltips.TokenAvoidanceStrength: Controls how forcefully creature particles move away from avoided tokens.
ParamTooltips.SoundFxEnabled: Enable Sound FX rule matching for this effect.
ParamTooltips.SoundFxManualSoundIds: Select the sound entries used when the matching Sound FX rule uses Manual multi-sound mode.
ParamTooltips.AudioAware: React to audio peaks. Useful for sounds such as thunder; applies to any bass-heavy audio on the selected channels.
ParamTooltips.AudioChannels: Which audio channels to react to.
ParamTooltips.AudioBassThreshold: Bass level required to trigger Audio Aware reactions. Higher = less sensitive.
ParamTooltips.Jitter: How jagged the bolt path is. Higher values create more chaotic arcs and branching.
ParamTooltips.DirectionalMovement: Constrains Horizontal bolts to the selected direction.
ParamTooltips.Spread: Determine spread offset from direction in degrees
ParamTooltips.LightningMode: Choose how bolts are generated: Horizontal streaks, Top Down strikes, or a mix of both.
ParamTooltips.BoltFrequency: How often a bolt spawns on average. Higher values produce more frequent bolts.
ParamTooltips.BoltLength: Controls overall bolt length. 1 applies the maximum configured length. In Top Down mode, this sets the foreshortened strike depth.
ParamTooltips.Branchiness: Controls how strongly the bolt branches. 0 disables branching; 1 applies the maximum configured branching.
ParamTooltips.SyncFlash: When enabled, Lightning Bolts will trigger flashes from the base Lightning filter and suppress its autonomous flashing so flashes occur only when bolts spawn.
ParamTooltips.TopDownScale: Scales the size of Top Down strikes without affecting Horizontal bolts. 1 applies the maximum configured size.
ParamTooltips.TopDownBolts: Maximum number of simultaneous Top Down strikes. In Variable Bolt Count mode, this is the maximum possible bolts per strike event.
ParamTooltips.TopDownBoltsVariable: If enabled, chooses a random number of Top Down bolts up to the maximum (biased toward lower counts). If disabled, always spawns exactly the maximum number.
ParamTooltips.TriggerChance: In Audio Aware mode, this controls how often audio triggers spawn a bolt. When Sync with Lightning Flash is enabled, this controls how often each flash also spawns a bolt.
ParamTooltips.FrostStrength: Controls how strongly the ice veil (frost) tints the scene. Higher = more frosty/opaque ice look.
ParamTooltips.Depth: Controls how much the under-ice layer contributes (movement/caustics). Higher = more visible depth beneath the ice.
ParamTooltips.VeinStrength: Darkens and adds subtle vein-like structure within the ice. 0 disables the veins.
ParamTooltips.SheenStrength: Strength of the sheen highlight layer. Higher values create brighter highlights.
ParamTooltips.SheenTint: Tint color for the sheen highlight layer.
ParamTooltips.Highlight: Strength of the highlight layer. Higher values create brighter highlights.
ParamTooltips.HighlightTint: Tint color for the highlight layer.
ParamTooltips.ReflectionStrength: Strength of the reflection-like sampling for glossy ice. Higher = stronger reflection.
ParamTooltips.ReflectionDistance: How far the reflection is sampled/offset. Higher = more pronounced reflection shift.
ParamTooltips.ReflectionBlur: Blur applied to the reflection sample. Higher = softer reflection.
ParamTooltips.ReflectionFresnel: Controls how view-angle dependent the reflection is. 1 = maximum configured edge weighting.
ParamTooltips.WaterTint: Tint color applied to the water layer or surface coloration.
ParamTooltips.WaterStrength: Strength of the animated under-ice water refraction and tint. Higher = more visible movement.
ParamTooltips.WaterSpeed: Speed of the under-ice water motion. 0 disables movement; 1 = maximum configured speed.
ParamTooltips.Caustics: Controls how sparse or widespread the sun-caustic filaments are. Lower = very fine, very sparse light lines; higher = broader, more frequent caustic coverage.
ParamTooltips.CausticStrength: How strongly the caustic lighting brightens the water surface. Higher = brighter, more obvious light-caustic streaks.
ParamTooltips.CausticsTint: Tint color applied to the caustic light contribution.
ParamTooltips.Refraction: Strength of refractive scene distortion. Higher values create more visible warping beneath the effect.
ParamTooltips.Distortion: Strength of scene distortion. Higher values create more visible warping.
ParamTooltips.HeatDistortion: Strength of heat shimmer distortion. Higher values create more visible scene warping around the fire.
ParamTooltips.Reflection: Strength of glossy sunlight and scene reflection on the water. Higher = more visible reflective sheen.
ParamTooltips.Sparkle: Adds a sunlight sheen and glinting highlight breakup similar to an icy surface sheen, but tuned for water. Higher = brighter, more natural sun-shimmer across the surface.
ParamTooltips.FlowingWater: Animate the water as a directional current instead of a mostly static surface shimmer.
ParamTooltips.FollowRegionPath: When enabled on a region-based Water effect, flow bends with the region shape and routes around curves and holes while still generally heading in the chosen direction.
ParamTooltips.PathInfluence: How strongly the flow hugs the region-derived path network instead of the raw direction. 0 = raw direction; 1 = maximum configured path-following.
ParamTooltips.Waves: Adds broad rolling swells to the water surface instead of choppy distortion. Can be combined with Flowing Water so the swells still travel downstream.
ParamTooltips.WaveStrength: Strength and height of the rolling swell motion. Higher = fuller, more obvious wave bulges.
ParamTooltips.Turbulence: Amount of irregular movement, breakup, and turbulent variation. Higher values create rougher motion.
ParamTooltips.WindDistortionManual: Distortion strength inside painted Manual Painting areas. Higher values create stronger local warping for objects such as trees or flags.
ParamTooltips.WindTurbulenceManual: Irregular movement inside painted Manual Painting areas. Higher values create rougher local motion.
ParamTooltips.WindSwayStrength: Strength of the slower directional bend inside painted Manual Painting areas. Higher values create larger tree, flag, or fabric motion.
ParamTooltips.WindSwayFrequency: Speed of the slower directional bend inside painted Manual Painting areas. Higher values create faster motion without adding high-frequency ripples.
ParamTooltips.Gustiness: Strength of gust variation. Higher values create stronger intermittent movement.
ParamTooltips.FlowSpeed: Speed of the directional water flow. 0 disables current motion; 1 = maximum configured current speed.
ParamTooltips.FlowStrength: How strongly the directional current influences the water motion. Higher = more pronounced downstream flow.
ParamTooltips.StillWaterSpeed: Animation speed for calm water when Flowing Water, Waves, and Vortex Water are disabled. 0 disables movement; 1 = maximum configured calm-water speed.
ParamTooltips.WaveSpeed: Speed of the wave motion. 0 disables wave travel; 1 = maximum configured wave speed.
ParamTooltips.VortexWater: Animate the water as a vortex centered within the region instead of directional flow.
ParamTooltips.VortexSize: Defines the radius of the fast inner vortex core. Higher values keep the high-speed center broader before rotation tapers outward.
ParamTooltips.VortexSpeed: Controls vortex rotation speed. 0 disables vortex motion; 1 uses the maximum configured swirl speed.
ParamTooltips.VortexStrength: Strength of the vortex deformation and swirl. Higher = stronger rotational pull.
ParamTooltips.VortexClockwise: Sets the vortex rotation direction. Enabled = clockwise; disabled = counterclockwise.
ParamTooltips.Background: Render a persistent settled-snow surface behind this effect. The surface follows the effect's stack placement, scene or Region mask, Levels selection, and below-token/tile settings.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundMode: Apply the settled-snow background immediately or let it fill procedurally over time.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundDuration: Seconds required for an accumulating background to reach full coverage.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundOpacity: Maximum opacity of the settled-snow background at full coverage.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundFillVariation: Controls how unevenly snow settles over time. Higher values create more distinct patches that spread and merge across the scene.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundDriftStrength: Controls the apparent difference between shallow snow and raised drifts. Drifts align loosely with the snow movement direction.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundDriftScale: Sets the broad size of snowdrifts in grid spaces. Larger values create wider, slower-changing banks.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackgroundOpacity: Maximum visual strength of the snow storm background. The snow storm background caps this normalized control at the equivalent of the previous 0.7 opacity.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackgroundSweep: Adds the broad wind-swept snow sheet to the snow storm background instead of tying it to the main snowflake density.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackgroundSweepOpacity: Controls how visible the wind-swept background snow sheet is.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackgroundSweepScale: Controls the size and spacing of the sweeping background snow bands.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackgroundSweepSpeed: Controls how quickly the sweeping background snow sheet moves.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackgroundSweepStrength: Controls how dense and contrasty the sweeping background snow sheet appears.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundTrails: Create visible background trails as tokens move through the surface. By default trails remain for the current canvas session; Refill Trails Over Time can gradually restore the background.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundTrailRefill: Gradually restores each token trail over the configured Trail Refill Time. Newer trail segments refill independently from older ones.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundTrailStrength: Controls how much the background surface is displaced along token trails.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackground: Render a persistent field of settled particles behind the active effect. The field follows the same stack placement, scene or Region mask, Levels selection, and below-token/tile settings.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundMode: Place the complete scatter field immediately or let individual particles arrive in clustered patches over time.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundDuration: Seconds required for the settled particle field to reach its configured ground coverage.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundOpacity: Maximum opacity of settled particles at full coverage.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundCoverage: Controls the number of settled particles generated across the scene or Region.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundFillVariation: Controls how strongly nearby particles arrive together. Higher values create more obvious patches and piles that grow over time.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundPileStrength: Controls how strongly particles cluster into overlapping piles instead of distributing evenly.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundPileSize: Sets the broad size of clustered piles in grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundParticleSize: Controls the rendered size of particles resting on the ground independently of the moving particle scale.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundInteraction: Allow visible token trails to push, spin, and briefly lift nearby settled particles while moving through them. Displaced particles settle in their new positions for the current canvas session.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundInteractionStrength: Controls how forcefully token trails push nearby particles.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundInteractionSwirl: Adds sideways flutter and spin to particles disturbed by token trails.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundInteractionLiftChance: Controls the chance that a trailed particle briefly lifts above the ground before settling.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundInteractionSettleTime: Approximate time trailed particles remain active before friction brings them to rest.
ParamTooltips.DarknessActivationRange: Only render this effect when the current scene darkness level falls within the selected range.
ParamTooltips.BelowForeground: Renders effects underneath the active foreground image visually.
ParamTooltips.DarknessActivationMin: Minimum scene darkness level required for this effect to render.
ParamTooltips.DarknessActivationMax: Maximum scene darkness level allowed for this effect to render.
ParamTooltips.BlendMode: How the adjusted color result blends with the sampled scene color.
ParamTooltips.Levels: Limit this scene effect to the selected scene levels. Leave it on All Levels to render everywhere.
ParamTooltips.DarknessActivationEnabled: Enable scene darkness gating for this effect. When disabled, the effect renders at all darkness levels.
ParamTooltips.AuroraMode: Side View draws horizontal curtains, Top Down draws winding overhead bands, and Horizon draws a curtain that enters and exits along the top edge while dipping toward the viewer.
ParamTooltips.AuroraPalette: Selects a preset palette. Custom Colors uses the saved custom palette.
ParamTooltips.AuroraColorDepth: Darkest/deepest color stop used for faint structure, shadow, and atmospheric depth.
ParamTooltips.AuroraColorLower: Lower curtain color used in dimmer folds and distant ribbons.
ParamTooltips.AuroraColorCore: Main aurora color used through the body of the ribbons.
ParamTooltips.AuroraColorBright: Bright edge color used for visible curtain edges and active ray structures.
ParamTooltips.AuroraColorGlow: Highest-energy glow color used for highlights and luminous crowns.
ParamTooltips.AuroraCount: Number of aurora ribbons or curtain sheets to draw. In Horizon mode, higher values create distinct top-anchored passes rather than simply widening one beam.
ParamTooltips.AuroraRibbonWidth: Controls the apparent width of each ribbon. 1 applies the maximum configured ribbon width.
ParamTooltips.AuroraSoftness: Controls how diffused each ribbon edge is. Higher values create softer atmospheric glow.
ParamTooltips.AuroraSideVerticalPosition: Sets the average height of horizontal curtains in Side View mode.
ParamTooltips.AuroraSideCurtainHeight: Controls how far Side View curtains fall away from the main band.
ParamTooltips.AuroraTopDownDepth: Adds secondary glow and shadow to enhance depth.
ParamTooltips.AuroraHorizonAngle: Slants the pass-overhead path so the aurora crosses the scene at an angle.
ParamTooltips.AuroraHorizonStartPosition: Horizontal position of the small top-edge anchor where the aurora begins entering the scene.
ParamTooltips.AuroraHorizonEndPosition: Horizontal position of the small top-edge exit point where the aurora curves back out of the scene.
ParamTooltips.AuroraHorizonDip: How far the aurora dips down toward the viewer before curving back up to the top edge. Higher values make the overhead portion larger and closer.
ParamTooltips.AuroraHorizonHazeStrength: Controls the strength of the broad Horizon field veil between the main aurora ribbons. 1 applies the maximum configured haze strength.
ParamTooltips.AuroraHorizonHazeHeight: Controls how far the broad Horizon field veil extends down the scene. 1.0 reaches the full scene height; lower values keep haze closer to the aurora band.
ParamTooltips.AuroraTopDownHazeStrength: Controls the strength of the broad Top Down haze and between-band veil. 1 applies the maximum configured haze strength.
ParamTooltips.AuroraMixedColors: Slowly rotates the five selected aurora colors through the different color roles over time, creating gradual color-role shifts.
ParamTooltips.FireInnerColor: Optional tint for the brightest inner flame pixels. Disable Apply to use the effect's default inner flame color.
ParamTooltips.FireOuterColor: Optional tint for the darker outer flame pixels and glow. Disable Apply to use the effect's default outer flame color.
ParamTooltips.FireSmokeColor: Color used by top-down smoke haze and soot.
ParamTooltips.FireHeat: Color temperature of the flame. Lower values keep the fire cooler/oranger; higher values push the center and Core Flame tint toward hotter white color.
ParamTooltips.FireWind: How strongly the upper flame volume, smoke, and heat shimmer sway side-to-side with air currents.
ParamTooltips.FireSmoke: Amount of top-down smoke haze generated by the Fire filter. 0 disables smoke.
ParamTooltips.FireFlicker: How strongly the fire brightness and shape pulse over time. Lower values are steadier; higher values create more visible flaring.
ParamTooltips.FireSpeed: Controls how quickly the Fire filter animation moves. Lower values create slower, heavier fire motion without changing density or scale.
ParamTooltips.FireSpread: Controls how much of the viewed area fills with the anchored fire base and projected upper flame volume. 1 applies the maximum configured spread.
ParamTooltips.GlowRadius: Pixel radius for the optional particle glow filter. Higher values cost more GPU time.
ParamTooltips.FireCoreColor: Tint for the hottest center of each filtered fire area. The default is a warm white; choose a pale blue for a blue-hot core accent.
ParamTooltips.ManualPlacement: Uses this effect as a custom placement layer on the current Scene.
ParamTooltips.PlacementActions: Controls for placing, undoing, or clearing manually placed particles on the current Scene.
ParamTooltips.ManualFloatRadius: Maximum distance a manually placed ghost can drift from its placement point, in grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.LightSource: Creates and manages Foundry ambient light sources for manually placed fire particles on the current Scene.
ParamTooltips.LightRadius: Dim light radius for each manually placed fire, measured in grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.LightBrightRadius: Bright light radius for each manually placed fire, measured in grid spaces. This cannot exceed the dim light radius.
ParamTooltips.LightColor: Color used by the linked Foundry ambient light source.
ParamTooltips.LightIntensity: Color intensity and opacity of the linked Foundry ambient light source.
ParamTooltips.LightFlicker: Torch animation strength for the linked Foundry ambient light source. Set to 0 for a steady light.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokens: Applies a client-side token-shaped pulsing heat and smoke indicator to visible tokens that pass through this particle fire effect.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokenDuration: Seconds the visual burn remains after the token leaves the fire. Re-entering the fire refreshes this timer.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokenRadius: How close a token must be to a fire particle source or manual fire placement to trigger burning, measured in grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokenScale: Coverage multiplier for the pulsing burn indicator. Heat stays clipped to the token artwork alpha; values above 0.5 allow ember and smoke detail to drift just beyond the token shape.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokenOpacity: Maximum opacity of the token-shaped pulsing burn indicator.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokenIntensity: Controls the amount of smoke, ember, and pulse detail blended into each burning token.
ParamTooltips.BurnTokenTint: Optional override color for the token burn pulse. Disable Apply to use the fire particle tint or the default orange heat color.
ParamTooltips.Intensity: Controls effect intensity. 0 disables the effect when supported; 1 applies the maximum configured intensity.
ParamTooltips.SandBackground: Render a persistent settled-sand surface behind the sandstorm. The surface follows the effect's stack placement, scene or Region mask, Levels selection, and below-token/tile settings.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundMode: Apply complete ground sand immediately or let deposits appear in small random areas, expand, and merge over time.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundOpacity: Maximum opacity of the settled-sand surface at full coverage.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundFillVariation: Controls how unevenly sand deposits over time. Higher values produce more distinct accumulation patches before they merge.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundDuneHeight: Controls the apparent height difference between shallow sand and raised wind-built dunes.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundDuneSize: Sets the broad size of sand dunes in grid spaces. Larger values create wider banks and slower-changing elevation.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundRipples: Controls fine grit and speckled sand texture instead of long wind-line ripples. Higher values make the settled sand look rougher and more granular.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundMigration: Slowly moves and reshapes settled dunes after the surface reaches full coverage. The synchronized motion continues across clients and canvas reloads.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundMigrationSpeed: Approximate downwind travel in grid spaces per minute. Broad banks move more slowly than fine ridges so the surface reshapes instead of sliding as one texture.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundTrails: Let visible tokens press darker, lower trails into accumulated sand as they move.
ParamTooltips.SandBackgroundTrailStrength: Controls the depth and visibility of trails pressed into the sand.
ParamTooltips.RainBackground: Render a persistent wet-surface layer behind the rain effect. The layer follows the effect's stack placement, scene or Region mask, Levels selection, and below-token/tile settings.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundMode: Apply the complete wet-surface background immediately or let the wet coverage build over time.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundGroundMovementSpeed: Controls how quickly the moving rain-water sheet travels across the wet ground background. Lower values make the ground water calmer; higher values make it run faster.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundCoverage: Controls how much of the scene or Region carries rain-wet ground, subtle depth shadowing, and moving rain-sheen background at full coverage.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundFillVariation: Controls how unevenly the wet-surface background fills in over time. Higher values create more varied arrival times and patch shapes before full coverage.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundOpacity: Maximum visual strength of the wet surface. Lower values preserve more of the original map while still showing rain-darkened depth and highlights.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundReflectivity: Controls the broad reflective wet-surface sheen that develops across the scene as rain accumulates.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundShimmer: Controls animated specular highlights across the wet surface. Set this to 0 for a calmer rain-darkened surface.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundShimmerSpeed: Controls how quickly local specular shimmer pulses across the wet surface. Lower values are nearly still; higher values create visibly faster sparkling highlights.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundInteraction: Create short-lived water splashes and wake highlights from visible token trails moving through the rain wet-surface background.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundInteractionStrength: Controls how bright and forceful token-created water trails appear.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundInteractionSettleTime: Approximate time token-created splashes and wakes remain visible before fading back into the wet surface.
ParamTooltips.WindPaintBrushSize: Sets the radius of the Paint and Erase brushes in grid spaces.
ParamTooltips.ManualPainting: Restrict movement to painted areas while leaving the subtle visible wind sheen across the full Scene or Region.
ParamTooltips.WindMovementPaint: Restrict scene displacement to painted areas while leaving the subtle visible wind sheen across the full effect area.
ParamTooltips.WindPaintControls: Paint areas that should move, erase existing coverage, or clear the current Scene or Region mask.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundPatchSize: Sets the typical spacing and footprint of rain-depth patches in grid spaces. Smaller values create tighter, less connected shadowing; larger values create broader depth variation.
ParamTooltips.RainBackgroundInteractionLiftChance: Controls how often token-created rain-water trails throw small side splashes along the token footprint edges. Set this to 0 for wake highlights only.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundInteractionElevationThreshold: Tokens higher than this elevation above the effects ground level do not carve trails. Leave empty to let tokens at any elevation affect the background. In regions and V14 scene levels, the bottom elevation is used and empty/infinite bottoms are treated as 0. In V13, scene effects use elevation 0.
ParamTooltips.SnowstormBackground: Render a persistent settled-snow surface beneath the snow storm effect. The surface follows the same stack placement, scene or Region mask, Levels selection, and below-token/tile settings as the standard snow background.
ParamTooltips.BackgroundTrailRefillDuration: Seconds required for the background to refill each token trail after Refill Trails Over Time is enabled.
ParamTooltips.FogTokenTrails: Moving visible tokens temporarily lower fog opacity along their path. The cleared area fades smoothly back to normal fog opacity.
ParamTooltips.TokenTrailWidth: Sets trail width as a multiplier of the moving token's footprint. 1 is approximately the token's size.
ParamTooltips.FogTokenTrailStrength: Controls how strongly moving tokens lower fog opacity along their recent path.
ParamTooltips.FogTokenTrailSettleTime: Seconds before cleared fog paths fill back in after token movement.
ParamTooltips.SynchronizedDirection: Use the active Wind or Duststorm direction for this effect.
ParamTooltips.SynchronizedDirectionWaiting: Controlled by Wind or Duststorm when one is active.
ParamTooltips.DirectionRandomization: Randomly shifts the effect direction over time. At 1, the direction can randomize anywhere around the full compass.
ParamTooltips.DirectionChangeTime: Average time in seconds between smooth random direction changes.
ParamTooltips.DirectionRandomizationRadius: Maximum angle each random direction change can move from the current direction. At 1, each change can use the full randomized direction range.
ParamTooltips.BubbleTokenTrails: Pop bubbles that moving tokens pass through.
ParamTooltips.BubbleTokenTrailStrength: Controls how strongly moving tokens pop nearby bubbles and how visible the pop spray appears.
ParamTooltips.ScatterBackgroundInteractionSettleImpact: Controls how strongly disturbed particles bounce when they settle back onto the ground.
ParamTooltips.LeafTurbulence: Adds small independent changes to leaf travel direction.
ParamTooltips.LeafGustiness: Adds shared wind pulses that vary leaf travel speed.
ParamTooltips.DepthVariation: Correlates leaf size, opacity, and speed to create subtle foreground and background depth.
ParamTooltips.LeafLiveliness: Adds subtle per-leaf flex and shape variation without changing the selected texture.
ParamTooltips.SpawnMode: Chooses whether leaves spawn across the view, along the top edge, or along the edge facing into the selected wind direction.
ParamTooltips.LeafRipple: Adds smooth per-leaf flex, edge tilt, and light variation so leaf textures appear less flat.
ParamTooltips.LeafEdgeDefinition: Darkens and slightly extends leaf edges for a more distinct stylized silhouette. Set to 0 to disable the effect.
ParamTooltips.LeafEdgeWidth: Controls the width of the leaf edge treatment in screen pixels.
ParamTooltips.NeonCoreColor: Sets the Fill and Outline color. Disable Apply to retain matched source colors.
ParamTooltips.NeonHaloColor: Sets the Halo color. Disable Apply to derive it from matched source colors.
ParamTooltips.NeonStyle: Selects Fill, Outline, or Fill + Outline.
ParamTooltips.NeonSourceColorMatching: Chooses Color Families, Custom Colors, or both for source matching.
ParamTooltips.NeonDetectionMode: Chooses the brightness, saturation, or combined signal used for Color Family matching.
ParamTooltips.NeonAffectedSourceColors: Selects eligible source color families. All selects every family.
ParamTooltips.NeonCustomSourceColor: Selects a custom source color to match. Disable Apply to ignore this slot.
ParamTooltips.NeonThreshold: Sets the minimum Color Family match signal. Lower values include more source pixels.
ParamTooltips.NeonSmoothness: Softens the Threshold edge. 0 is hard; higher values broaden the transition.
ParamTooltips.NeonCustomColorRange: Sets allowed color variation. Shade variation is controlled separately.
ParamTooltips.NeonCustomShadeRange: Sets allowed lighter and darker shade variation.
ParamTooltips.NeonIntensity: Controls overall Neon strength. Values above 0.5 boost Fill brightness more strongly; 1 applies the maximum configured intensity.
ParamTooltips.NeonHaloStrength: Controls halo brightness. 0 disables the halo.
ParamTooltips.NeonHaloRadius: Controls halo spread. 0 disables the halo; larger values cost more to render.
ParamTooltips.NeonOutlineDefinition: Sharpens the matched boundary. Higher values create a firmer outline.
ParamTooltips.NeonOutlineWidth: Controls outline width around matched areas.
ParamTooltips.NeonOutlineStrength: Controls outline brightness. 0 disables the outline; 1 applies the maximum configured strength.
ParamTooltips.NeonOutlinePosition: Places the outline outside, centered on, or inside the matched boundary.
ParamTooltips.NeonPulse: Cycles Neon between on and off. Pulse and Slide are mutually exclusive.
ParamTooltips.NeonPulseOnDuration: Sets how long Neon remains fully on during each Pulse cycle.
ParamTooltips.NeonPulseOffDuration: Sets how long Neon remains fully off during each Pulse cycle.
ParamTooltips.NeonPulseFadeDuration: Sets the fade time between Pulse states. 0 switches instantly.
ParamTooltips.NeonSlide: Sweeps Neon across the effect area. Slide and Pulse are mutually exclusive.
ParamTooltips.NeonSlideTravelDuration: Sets the base time for the active band to cross the effect area.
ParamTooltips.NeonSlidePauseDuration: Sets the base pause between sweeps.
ParamTooltips.NeonSlideSoftness: Softens the sweep-band edges. 0 is hard; 1 applies the widest feather.
ParamTooltips.NeonFlicker: Adds irregular brightness variation to Fill, Outline, and Halo.
ParamTooltips.NeonFlickerSpeed: Controls how quickly the flicker pattern changes.
ParamTooltips.NeonFlickerAmount: Controls flicker depth. 0 disables variation; 1 applies the strongest dimming.
ParamTooltips.AboveDarkness: Presents the effect's luminous contribution above scene darkness.
ParamTooltips.PredatorThermalStrength: Blends the false-color thermal palette into the source image. 0 retains source colors; 1 uses full thermal color.
ParamTooltips.PredatorThermalContrast: Separates cool and hot values in the thermal palette. Higher values create stronger temperature differences.
ParamTooltips.PredatorEdgeDefinition: Highlights local temperature boundaries for sharper thermal silhouettes.
ParamTooltips.PredatorScanlineStrength: Controls scanline brightness variation. Set to 0 to hide the scanline pattern.
ParamTooltips.PredatorSpeed: Controls scanline movement speed. 0 stops movement; 1 applies the maximum configured speed.
ParamTooltips.PredatorTokenHeatSeek: Use full thermal vision with visible matching tokens as heat sources and cooler surroundings. Existing masking and layer placement still apply.
ParamTooltips.PredatorTokenHeatSeekDispositions: Choose which visible token dispositions register as heat sources. Hidden and occluded tokens are excluded.
ParamTooltips.FireworksCustomColor: Enable this color to include it in the custom palette. If all five colors are disabled, fireworks use white.
ParamTooltips.FireworksMixedColors: Mix colors from the chosen palette within each shell. When disabled, each shell uses one color from its chosen palette.
ParamTooltips.FireworksPeriod: In Burst mode, the time between launches or volleys. In Dragon mode, the pause after the dragon and its follow-up burst finish before the next dragon launches. Measured in milliseconds.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDuration: Time from detonation until the final sparks extinguish.
ParamTooltips.FireworksVolley: Launch 1-10 shells with a short stagger. Each shell independently chooses from the selected burst styles and color palettes.
ParamTooltips.FireworksRadius: Nominal size in scene grid units. New fireworks fit the visible scene or Region bounds; dragons reserve space for wings and flight path.
ParamTooltips.FireworksShellSize: Thickness of the rising shell and its launch trail, independent of the burst or dragon size. Applies in both viewing modes.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonDuration: Time from ignition through formation, flight, and the spark finale. A matching firework then bursts before the next dragon starts.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonPatterns: Choose one or more flight patterns. Each dragon randomly chooses from the selected patterns. No selection uses both patterns. Random choices can repeat.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonSpeed: Speed along the looping flight path, independent of Dragon Duration. The default 0.5 preserves the standard flight pace; 1 doubles it. Zero pauses path travel while body motion and wind drift continue.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonDetail: Spark density defining the body, head, wings, tail, and trailing haze. Higher values add detail and rendering work.
ParamTooltips.FireworksMode: Burst launches timed firework shells. Dragon repeats one flight and spark finale at a time.
ParamTooltips.FireworksStyle: Choose one or more burst styles. Each shell independently chooses from the selected styles, including within a volley. Mixed or no selection uses all five styles; Mixed overrides other selections. Random choices can repeat.
ParamTooltips.FireworksPalette: Choose one or more color palettes. Each shell independently chooses one of the selected palettes. No selection uses Celebration. Include Custom Colors to use the five individual color choices.
ParamTooltips.FireworksTimingVariation: Randomize the Burst-mode launch interval by up to 35% of Period at the maximum setting. Zero keeps a regular cadence.
ParamTooltips.FireworksSparks: Number of sparks in each Burst-mode shell. Higher values make denser bursts.
ParamTooltips.FireworksLaunchHeight: Height of the rising rocket trail in grid units. Dragon launches shorten to fit the available space. The trail appears foreshortened in Top Down view.
ParamTooltips.FireworksTrailLength: Length of the sparks left behind the moving firework. In Dragon mode, also controls the lifetime of released sparks and haze, which drift from their release positions.
ParamTooltips.FireworksGravity: Downward pull on firework sparks and the Dragon spark finale. Does not change the dragon flight path.
ParamTooltips.FireworksWind: Amount of wind drift applied to fireworks. In Dragon mode, adds a small drift to the flight and finale.
ParamTooltips.FireworksWindDirection: Direction of wind drift. Has no visible effect when Wind Drift is zero.
ParamTooltips.FireworksBrightness: Intensity of the spark cores and glow. Higher values brighten overlapping sparks and haze; zero hides the effect.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonDirection: Orientation of the looping flight path. The dragon turns to follow each curve. With Flight Distance at zero, sets the direction the hovering dragon faces.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonTravel: Amount of the available area covered by the looping flight path. Higher values make wider loops; zero holds position apart from body motion and wind drift.
ParamTooltips.FireworksDragonWingbeat: Wing-flap speed. Zero holds the wings still.

Info.Title: FXMaster Overview
Info.Heading: What can FXMaster do?
Info.Intro: FXMaster helps GMs add atmosphere to a Scene with animated particles, visual filters, region-based effects and effect suppression, layers, reusable macros, and more!
Info.PreviewPlaceholder: Add an example video or image URL in fxmaster-info.js for this preview.

Particles.Title: Particle Effects
Particles.Text: Add scene-wide ambience such as rain, snow, fog, clouds, embers, stars, birds, bats, spiders, and other weather or creature effects. Each effect comes with various parameters to customize the effect's look: density, scale, speed, tint, and more.

Filters.Title: Filter Effects
Filters.Text: Change the look of the Scene with visual treatments like color grading, bloom, fog, old film, underwater distortion, predator vision, or lightning. Each effect comes with a number of different parameters to customize the effect's look.

Regions.Title: Regions and Masking
Regions.Text: Use Region behaviors to place particles or filters only in specific areas, react to token enter or exit events, respect elevation, or suppress scene effects with softer edges. In V14, FXMaster region behaviors also support native Scene Level selections for even more flexible placement and layering options.

PlacementLevels.Title: Placement and Levels
PlacementLevels.Text: Placement options route Scene effects below tokens, below tiles, or below foreground coverage so particles and filters sit where you want. On Scenes using native Levels on V14, Scene-wide effects can also be limited to selected floors.

Layers.Title: Manage Layers
Layers.Text: Review enabled scene, region, and API-created effects in one stack, then move effects up or down to control how FXMaster effects render over one another.

ApiEffects.Title: Manage API Effects
ApiEffects.Text: Inspect, edit, or remove effects that were added by macros, presets, or third-party integrations without digging through Scene flags.

SoundEffects.Title: Manage Sound Effects
SoundEffects.Text: When FXMaster+ is active, create sound rules that play when matching particles or filters are activated with SoundFX on, these rules can apply to both scene-wide or region-specific effects. Regions have additional configuration flexibility including easing and wall blocking/muffling options.

UserParticles.Title: Manage User Particle Effects
UserParticles.Text: When FXMaster+ is active, define custom particle effects from your own images and icons using ambient float or directional drift motion styles.

Macros.Title: Save Particle and Filter Effects as Macro
Macros.Text: Save the current particle and filter setup as a reusable macro from the FXMaster controls. Helpful when quick playback or toggles are useful for recurring ambience. Macros can also stack the same effect multiple times for additional customization.

Cleanup.Title: Clear Scene Particle and Filter Effects
Cleanup.Text: The cleanup control clears all Scene-level Particle Effects and Filter Effects from the current Scene.

Performance.Title: Performance Tips
Performance.Text: Particle density can affect performance, especially on large Scenes. FXMaster leverages Foundry's Performance Mode setting to allow limiting density on a per-user basis: Low = 25% of current particle density, Medium = 50%, High = 75%, and Maximum = 100%.
